header.title: OpenAEC SuperCloud
header.heroAlt: OpenAEC Desktop App: overview with the main folder, storage use, the files being transferred and the linked project folders
header.label: Files and collaboration
header.tagline: All your project files in sync on every computer, and safely shared with whoever you choose
header.desc: Link a folder on your computer to a project space in your OpenAEC environment and keep working in your own programs. The OpenAEC Desktop App keeps the files in sync, shares them with a link and sends large files without a separate service.

meta.description: Sync, share and send project files through your own environment in the OpenAEC SuperCloud. Free, open-source desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux, with storage in the EU.
meta.title: OpenAEC SuperCloud — OpenAEC Foundation

sync.alt: Choose folders window for a project space: every folder ticked except the photos, with the size and number of files per folder
sync.title: Work in an ordinary folder, the rest happens on its own
sync.desc: As soon as you save a file, it goes to the project space, and your colleagues' changes come in on their own. For a large change, only the changed parts are transferred. Choose per space which folders come to this computer: the site photos can simply stay on the server.

spaces.alt: Spaces screen with the project spaces and shared folders on the left, and on the right the files in the Calculations folder, two of them locked by a colleague
spaces.title: One space per project, with the people who belong to it
spaces.desc: Each space has members with a role: manager, writer, reader or guest. Browse the files on the server, see who has locked a file and create new folders. Folders that another party shares with you are listed under Shared with me, and you link them just as easily.

share.alt: Share window for a PDF: a link for outsiders with password and expiry date, sharing with a colleague and the list of who has access
share.title: Share with a link or with a role
share.desc: Choose Share on a file or folder, in the app or in File Explorer, and create a link for someone without an account, with a password and an expiry date. Give a colleague the role Can view, Can edit or Can manage. Under Who has access you change a role or withdraw access again.

send.alt: Send with OpenAEC window: a folder and two files, with recipients, a message, an expiry date and a password
send.title: Send large files without a transfer service
send.desc: Choose Send with OpenAEC in the right-click menu, also outside your project folders. The recipient gets a download link, by e-mail if you like, with a message, an expiry date and a password. If the connection drops, you resume where you were; under My transfers you see the downloads and withdraw a link.

assistant.alt: Assistant screen: a question about a basis-of-design report as an attachment, answered with a table of the loads and then a short e-mail
assistant.title: Ask the assistant, with your files attached
assistant.desc: Drag a PDF, Word or Excel file, text or image into the conversation and ask your question. The questions go to OpenAEC's AI service in the EU and use your environment's AI credit. Your conversations stay on your own computer.

tools.alt: Tools screen with cards for the OpenAEC apps: installed, with an update or not yet installed, with buttons to start, update or remove
tools.title: Keep all OpenAEC apps up to date in one place
tools.desc: The Tools tab shows which OpenAEC apps you have and which ones have a new version. Install, update and start with one click, even without a connection to your environment. The app only fetches releases from OpenAEC-Foundation and checks every download.

notice.text: The app works with an account in the OpenAEC SuperCloud.

features.label: Features
features.heading: Your project folders, in sync everywhere and properly shared
features.sub: Start with the highlights, or pick a topic.

twoway.title: Two-way sync
twoway.desc: A local folder and a space stay the same: as soon as you save something and as soon as the server reports something new.

delta.title: Only what has changed
delta.desc: For a large model, only the changed blocks are transferred; the app shows how much that saves.

conflict.title: No work lost in a conflict
conflict.desc: If two people worked on the same file at the same time, both versions are kept.

select.title: Choose folders
select.desc: Per space you decide which folders come to this computer, and whether new folders come along automatically.

explorer.title: One folder in File Explorer
explorer.desc: On Windows, OpenAEC Cloud sits in the navigation pane, with a subfolder per space.

ondemand.title: Files on demand
ondemand.desc: On Windows, new files are online-only at first and come in as soon as you open them. You can free up space too.

icons.title: Status on every file
icons.desc: On Windows, File Explorer shows per file and folder whether it is up to date, busy or online-only.

progress.title: Progress and storage
progress.desc: What is being transferred, the speed, the time remaining and how much storage your environment has left. Pause from the system tray.

ignore.title: Ignore list and awkward names
ignore.desc: Temporary files stay out, your own patterns go in .openaecignore, and names Windows cannot handle are skipped cleanly.

space.title: Spaces with roles
space.desc: A space per project or department, with members as manager, writer, reader or guest.

newspace.title: New space with folder layout
newspace.desc: An environment manager creates a space from the app, with a fixed folder layout as a template.

sharedwithme.title: Shared with me
sharedwithme.desc: Link folders from other parties like a space. With read-only access nothing goes to the server.

browse.title: Browse files on the server
browse.desc: Browse a space without linking it, create folders and see who has locked a file.

lock.title: Locking and versions
lock.desc: Lock a file so colleagues see you are working on it, and open an earlier version.

link.title: Link for outsiders
link.desc: View and download without an account, with password and expiry date. If it is already in OpenAEC, nothing is uploaded.

roles.title: Share with a role
roles.desc: Can view, Can edit or Can manage. You never grant more than you have yourself.

send.title: Send with OpenAEC
send.desc: Files and whole folders with a download link, from the right-click menu in File Explorer, Finder, Nautilus, Dolphin or Nemo.

resume.title: Resume and withdraw
resume.desc: An interrupted transfer continues where it left off. Under My transfers you see the downloads and withdraw a link.

assistant.title: Assistant with attachments
assistant.desc: Questions about PDFs, Word and Excel files, text and images, through OpenAEC's AI service in the EU.

chats.title: Conversations on your own computer
chats.desc: Every conversation is stored locally and can be deleted. After each answer you see the usage.

tools.title: Install OpenAEC apps
tools.desc: Install, update, start and remove, with a check of every download on Windows and Linux.

updates.title: Updates itself
updates.desc: The app downloads new versions in the background and only installs them when you click, never in the middle of a sync.

cli.title: Command line for servers
cli.desc: The openaec-storage program syncs spaces on Linux without a screen, also as a service.

signin.title: Sign in once
signin.desc: Sign in through the browser with your OpenAEC account; the keys are kept in your operating system's keychain and renewed automatically.

download.title: Download v2026.44.10
download.lead: Free and open source, for Windows, macOS and Linux. You sign in with your account in the OpenAEC SuperCloud.
download.label: Download
download.mobileNote: OpenAEC SuperCloud is a desktop app. Download it on your computer.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.desc: Ask questions with attachments, with streamed answers and a choice of model.

explorer.title: OpenAEC Cloud in File Explorer
explorer.desc: Its own place in the navigation pane and an OpenAEC item in the Windows 11 right-click menu.

spaces.title: Spaces from the app
spaces.desc: Create a new space with folder layout, create folders and invite people straight away.

guests.title: Invite guests
guests.desc: From the share window you invite someone who is not yet a member of the space.

noupload.title: Sharing without upload
noupload.desc: If a file is already in OpenAEC, you create a link straight away, and Send does not upload it again either.

session.title: Stay signed in
session.desc: The app renews your session on its own; if it does expire, sync stops cleanly with a single message.

whatsnew.label: New in v2026.44
whatsnew.title: An assistant, and OpenAEC in File Explorer
whatsnew.desc: This week the app got a new name, the version numbers of all OpenAEC apps and a series of additions: from its own place in File Explorer to an assistant and new spaces from the app.

files.q: Which files can I sync and share?
files.a: Any kind of file, from drawings and IFC models to spreadsheets and photos. Only temporary files, whatever you put in .openaecignore and names Windows cannot handle are skipped. The assistant reads PDF, Word, Excel, text and images.

install.q: Do I need to install anything?
install.a: Yes, the OpenAEC Desktop App for Windows, macOS or Linux. Then you sign in to your environment through the browser and link the spaces you want. For servers without a screen there is the openaec-storage command-line program.

price.a: The app is free and open source. You do need an account in the OpenAEC SuperCloud; you sign up on the SuperCloud page, which also says how much storage comes with an account. The assistant uses your environment's AI credit.

save.a: In the storage of your own environment in the OpenAEC SuperCloud, in the EU, together with their versions. On your computer they sit in ordinary folders in their own format: there is no separate file format.

systems.q: Which systems does it run on?
systems.a: Windows (installer or MSI), macOS (universal .dmg for Intel and Apple Silicon) and Linux (.deb or AppImage). Sync, sharing and sending work everywhere. Status icons, files on demand and the place in the navigation pane are still Windows-only.

practice.q: Does it fit how construction projects work?
practice.a: Yes. You work with a space per project, with a fixed folder layout, and give outside parties such as a contractor or reviewer a guest role or a link with an expiry date. Locking shows who is working on a drawing or calculation report.

ai.q: What can an AI assistant do with it?
ai.a: The app has its own assistant that reads your files as attachments. An MCP connection that lets an external AI assistant work in your spaces itself does not exist yet; for scripts there is the openaec-storage command-line program.

nextcloud.a: No. The first versions were meant for Nextcloud, but the desktop app now works with the OpenAEC SuperCloud's own storage: spaces, roles, versions and transfers.

offline.a: Yes, with the files that are on your computer. As soon as you are connected again, your changes go to the server. Online-only files open again once you are connected and the app is running.

recipients.q: What does a recipient without an account see?
recipients.a: A download page in your own environment, with only what you shared or sent. If you set a password, they have to enter it first; the password is never in the e-mail. After the expiry date, or once you withdraw the link, it stops working.

tauri.title: Tauri 2 and Rust
tauri.desc: A small native app for Windows, macOS and Linux, with signed installers and automatic updates.

solid.title: SolidJS
solid.desc: The app's windows: overview, spaces, sharing, sending, assistant and tools.

sync.title: openaec-sync core
sync.desc: A Rust library without UI: BLAKE3 hashes per block, delta uploads, parallel transfers and conflict rules.

storage.title: OpenAEC Storage
storage.desc: The server side: a Frappe app for spaces, permissions, versions and transfers; the files themselves sit in S3 storage in the EU.

cloudfilter.title: Windows Cloud Filter API
cloudfilter.desc: Status icons, files on demand and the navigation pane, plus its own item in the Windows 11 right-click menu.

auth.title: OAuth 2 with PKCE
auth.desc: Sign-in through the browser; tokens in the operating system's keychain, with no secrets in the app.

tech.heading: Technology
tech.sub: For those who want to know how it is built.
